_what_this_is: The maintainer decision permitting ONE Phase-C1 Attempt-3R paid session at the REPRICED secure L40S rate of $1.09/h. A NEW artifact: logs/autoinit_c1_grant.json, logs/autoinit_c1_attempt2_grant.json and logs/autoinit_c1_attempt3_grant.json each authorized one issuance, and none of them can be reused. It is an INPUT to scripts/autoinit/issue_c1_authorization.py, which derives every identity — session commit, harness digest, isolation plan hash, science plan, execution preregistration, battery, teacher, scoring contract, seeds and ceiling — from the committed live tree and REFUSES if this document asserts any of them.
granted_by: maintainer, C1 repricing decision: reprice to the observed L40S securePrice of $1.09/h rather than keep waiting for $0.99/h. A pricing amendment only — no C1 science, source, harness, preregistration, battery, scorer or setup code changes. The unchanged frozen C1 protocol is authorized to execute exactly once at the repriced ceiling.
granted_for: Phase C1 fixed-path ATTENTION isolation — C1 Attempt-3R, repriced execution
covers: exactly one Attempt-3R C1 launch under the unchanged frozen protocol at a hard ceiling of $15.1475; 2 arms x 3 fresh seeds = 6 recovery probes, one confirmation evaluation per probe only after all six trainings complete, each admitted against its own observed generation protocol before scoring, followed by the frozen paired decision.
does_not_authorize: an allowance for another full C1 retry
cap_note: The project cumulative cap remains $283.7600 and is NOT raised. $19.7204 available at approval; worst case after one complete Attempt-3R is $279.1871 spent, leaving a $4.5729 reserve. That reserve is smaller than one C1 session and is not an allowance for another one.

repricing.price_field: gpuTypes[0].securePrice — the field session_runner actually prices on
repricing.not_this_field: communityPrice / lowestPrice.uninterruptablePrice, which read $0.79 at the same moment and describes a product this launcher does not provision. I reported that figure once as though it gated the launch; it did not.
repricing.launch_condition: launch only if the live securePrice is <= $1.09/h; --max-price 1.09
repricing.do_not: price-chase the market upward if it has moved past $1.09/h
repricing.minutes_unchanged: every minute assumption behind the ceiling is identical to the $0.99/h record; only the rate and the derived USD moved

supersedes.reason: it was issued at the $0.99/h ceiling and the launcher twice refused to create a pod at the live $1.09/h rate. Refusing is the correct behaviour: the ceiling was derived at a rate the provider no longer offers.
supersedes.provider_resources_created: NONE — a session is consumed when a provider resource is created, and none was

attempt_1.outcome: INFRASTRUCTURE ABORT at the bundle fetch
attempt_1.cause: no git bundle existed on the relay for the session commit; --bundle named an alias
attempt_1.closed_by: bundle_staged_gate (ninth), which round-trips the actual relay object

attempt_2.cause: the shared setup globs artifacts/stage1/*/checkpoint/config.json and C1 staged only tokenizer sidecars there
attempt_2.closed_by: rope_input_gate (tenth), plus a structural invariant separating loadability from the ROPE_OK staging dependency

attempt_3.outcome: NOT CONSUMED — launcher refused at the market rate, twice, before any provider resource existed
attempt_3.cause: the ceiling was priced at $0.99/h and the live securePrice is $1.09/h

prior_attempts.scientific_measurements_from_all_three: NONE. No replay gate, no training, no evaluation, no decision. C1 has never measured anything.

failure_semantics.market_price_above_ceiling: do not create a pod, do not raise the ceiling, do not loop waiting for a price; stop and report
failure_semantics.replay_mismatch: stop before recovery; preserve the finding; no automatic retry; a real replay result but NOT ATTENTION behavioural evidence
failure_semantics.generation_admission_failure: preserve the generations and the admission record; do not score that probe; evaluate no later probe; run no decision
failure_semantics.stage_i_precondition: six complete admitted and scored probe results

after_termination: confirm the pod is gone through GraphQL. No further attempt and no C2 without a new review.
